title: P2P Communication — Emergency Fix Deploy + Field Validation
rootCause: Contact conversation session often never subscribed to DataChannel: UI mounted before peer session existed; customer did not rebind on channel open. Inbound comm_* frames hit empty commHandlers and were dropped. Secondary: Android WebView may deliver DC text as Blob/ArrayBuffer.
fixApplied: onChannelOpen → syncRideCommChat / syncDriverRideCommChat (bind/subscribe when DC opens)

realDeviceResults.note: Agent cannot operate two physical Android phones. Operator must run checklist below and report PASS/FAIL.

prep: Hard refresh / clear site data on both phones (or reopen native shell against live hosting)
Start assigned ride; wait until live location moves (P2P up)
textChat: Driver sends Hello → Customer receives Hello
Customer sends OK → Driver receives OK
voiceCall: Driver calls Customer: ring, accept, audio both ways, end
Customer calls Driver: ring, accept, audio both ways, end
regression: Firebase fallback still engages if P2P drops
fieldChecklist.onFailure: copy(JSON.stringify(__SWIFTGO_COMM_TRACE__, null, 2)) on BOTH phones and STOP
